name: omd
description: Design like a person, not like the mean of the training set.

plugins.name: oh-my-design
plugins.description: One command, ultradesign: designs a marketing page, a multi-screen product or a redesign from a one-line request, one cycle at a time. Each cycle makes the work, has a cold outside eye look at it, and stops to show you; reply "one more" or "continue".
